name: Reign in Hell
body:
School abjuration; Level antipaladin 3, cleric/oracle 3, inquisitor 3, lathspell 3

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a crown worth at least 1,000 gp)

EFFECT

Range self
Target you
Duration 10 min./level (D)

DESCRIPTION

You don the crown and it begins to glow with a hellish light. For the duration you gain a +4 deflection bonus to AC and a +4 resistance bonus to saving throws against attacks or spells from evil outsiders.

While under the effects of this spell you are immune to any charm or compulsion effects from evil outsiders.

Any such effects that are active on you prior to the casting of this spell are suppressed while this spell is active.

Finally, while the spell is active, all evil outsiders start with a disposition of indifferent toward you and you gain a bonus to Charisma-based skills and ability checks against evil outsiders equal to 1/2 your class level.
